title: SynthEd: From Synthetic Data to Simulated Learners
description:
SynthEd is an agent-based simulation environment for open and distance learning (ODL) research. It combines persona-driven simulation with ten theoretical anchors to generate learner trajectories. Its equations and coefficients operationalize those anchors; validation grades summarize implemented checks rather than establishing external validity.

Simulation Engine

  • Four-phase theory dispatch. Public phase-method classes with no-argument constructors are auto-discovered; engagement-only classes require manual engine registration
  • Continuous employment, family-responsibility and internet-reliability scales alongside categorical states and decision thresholds
  • Multi-semester simulation with survivor carry-over, partial engagement/exhaustion recovery, transcript GPA and raw mastery accumulators, and decaying peer links
  • Raw perceived mastery informs cost-benefit, non-fit perception and competence beliefs; transcript GPA applies the grading floor separately

Calibration & Validation

  • Sobol sensitivity analysis (68 parameters) and NSGA-II optimization of dropout and GPA errors with engagement/dropout constraints. Larger-cohort multi-seed Pareto re-evaluation reduces sampling noise but does not remove it
  • The standard calibration script uses two optimizer seeds and ten validation seeds; some seeds overlap, so this is not a fully held-out evaluation
  • Conditional standalone validation across distributions, correlations, temporal coherence, quasi-identifier grouping and optional backstories. The current pipeline omits backstories and outcome labels: backstory checks are skipped and configured pass/distinction checks incorrectly report zero. Executed counts depend on supplied data and reference statistics
  • Measured cumulative-dropout targeting curves for one to four semesters, with configuration-transfer warnings, population-size checks and explicit target-attainment reporting

Configuration & Output

  • InstitutionalConfig, GradingConfig, EngineConfig and frozen PipelineConfig with JSON serialization; JSON event-week keys and custom carry-over objects require explicit reconstruction when loading
  • Seven OULAD-schema CSV tables with mapped categories and heuristic click counts; schema compatibility does not imply statistical or semantic equivalence
  • Optional LLM backstories with an estimated-cost confirmation threshold, not a hard spending cap
  • Optional Shiny/Plotly dashboard with presets, configuration import/export and a validation scorecard; interactive calibration optimization remains planned

Unreleased Changes

  • Deterministic peer sampling independent of UUID labels, complete-horizon validation histories and corrected multi-semester state continuity
  • Enrolled-course assignment load for exhaustion and event-triggered missed-assignment penalties
  • Refreshed targeting measurements, independent-seed checks and long-horizon diagnostic evidence; mechanism ablations are diagnostics rather than new production coefficients
  • Updated CI actions and uuid-utils compatibility, plus documentation corrections for APIs, model scope, measured evidence and security

v1.7.0 Highlights

  • Calibration methodology document gains a new §7 "Limitations & Identifiability" section: discusses parameter underidentification when many free parameters are fitted to two scalar objectives, archived across-seed dropout standard deviations of 1.45 and 1.96 percentage points for two candidates at n=1000 (descriptive variability, not a general noise floor), and the resulting parameter-interpretation caveats for downstream users
  • Aggregation bug fix: combined-profile JSON now contains all calibration seeds with explicit seed identifier (previously only the last seed was retained)
  • Cross-seed knee-point distance demoted from a binary release gate to an informational diagnostic, reflecting that cross-seed parameter scatter is a structural property of the model rather than an optimizer regression
  • Dashboard fixes: light-theme navbar contrast (1.1:1 → 17:1+), tablet 768 px run-bar overlap resolved, secondary-text contrast raised across all theme variables
  • Dashboard mode-split skeleton: "Configure" tab renamed to "Research", new "Calibrate" placeholder tab as scaffolding for upcoming OULAD-indexed calibration tooling

v1.8.0 Highlights

  • Auto-generated test inventory table in THEORY.md via doc_facts — sentinel-demarcated, AST-extracted module docstrings, eliminates manual table drift
  • SSQ integration test thresholds adjusted using a 50-seed study: eps lowered from 0.010 to 0.008; preserved summaries do not establish statistical power
  • Calibrate tab validation scorecard (PR B): collapsible accordion table with pass/fail markers, multiple-testing footer, empty-state handling
  • Dashboard accessibility pack: WCAG 2.4.7 focus-visible, tooltip ARIA, numeric-input locale fix, section heading contrast
  • analysis/ coverage uplift: nsga2_calibrator 69%↔94%, sobol_sensitivity 83%↔98%
  • 879 pytest tests across 49 files

v1.8.1 Highlights

  • Revived a silently-skipped validation test: the engagement–GPA correlation now actually runs (the pipeline emits the field the validator reads)
  • Hardened Sobol failed-sample handling — failed, crashed, or timed-out samples are retried in isolation on a fresh executor instead of zero-filling (which contaminated the S1/ST indices) or aborting on one worker death; fail-fast only when genuinely unrecoverable
  • Documentation and metadata accuracy: narrowed the "zero engine changes" claim, corrected the theory-ordering protocol docstring, and set the development-status classifier to Beta
  • CI dependency caps (numpy <2.5 / scipy <1.18) to avoid a scipy ndtr ufunc break in the validation suite
  • 890 pytest tests across 49 files

Use cases: dropout prediction, intervention simulation, synthetic benchmarking and educational data mining research. Default personas are fictional; the validation suite is not a formal privacy guarantee.
